title: The Gold Rush Behind a Civil War

sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: What we're about to talk about next might be the most undercover story of human misery on planet Earth.
sentences.zh: 我们接下来要谈论的可能是地球上最隐秘的人类苦难故事。

sentences.en: 20 years ago, a genocidal campaign in the Darfur region of Sudan shocked the world.
sentences.zh: 20年前，苏丹达尔富尔地区的种族灭绝运动震惊了世界。

sentences.en: Now, videos and images of new atrocities have captured global attention once more.
sentences.zh: 如今，关于新暴行的视频和图像再次引起了全球关注。

sentences.en: About 150,000 people have been killed.
sentences.zh: 约有15万人被杀害。

sentences.en: Some 12 million displaced, half of them children.
sentences.zh: 约1200万人流离失所，其中一半是儿童。

sentences.en: As another bloody conflict has returned to the region.
sentences.zh: 因为另一场血腥冲突又回到了该地区。

sentences.en: This week, the people of Al-Fashir, beaten and threatened, fled for their lives from a murderous militia that films itself unleashing ferocious violence.
sentences.zh: 本周，法希尔的人民在遭受殴打和威胁后，从一支拍摄自己实施残暴暴行的凶残民兵手中逃命。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Declan Walsh on what has become the worst humanitarian conflict in decades and the precious metal that is fueling it.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事德克兰·沃尔什将讲述几十年来最严重的人道主义冲突，以及助长这场冲突的贵金属。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月10日，星期一。

sentences.en: Declan, in recent weeks, there have been many horrific images coming out of Sudan, including what appear to be these very graphic execution videos.
sentences.zh: 德克兰，最近几周，苏丹传出了许多可怕的画面，包括看起来非常血腥的处决视频。

sentences.en: And this is all occurring as part of a civil war that you've been covering since the start.
sentences.zh: 这一切都发生在你从一开始就报道的内战之中。

sentences.en: Tell me what has happened in Darfur over the past couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 告诉我过去几周达尔富尔发生了什么。

sentences.en: Well, after 18 months of a pretty brutal siege led by this paramilitary group, the Rapid Support Forces, which had been trying to seize control of this city called Al-Fashir.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在那个准军事组织“快速支援部队”进行了18个月的残酷围困后，他们一直试图夺取法希尔这座城市的控制权。

sentences.en: It was the last major urban center in western Sudan that was beyond its control.
sentences.zh: 这是苏丹西部最后一个不在其控制之下的主要城市中心。

sentences.en: It finally broke the siege and its troops seized the entire city.
sentences.zh: 它最终打破了围困，其部队占领了整座城市。

sentences.en: They expelled the Sudanese military from it.
sentences.zh: 他们将苏丹军队驱逐了出去。

sentences.en: And what followed was really days of reports of atrocities against about a quarter million civilians who'd been trapped inside the city.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是关于被困在城内的约25万平民遭受暴行的报道，持续了好几天。

sentences.en: First, we saw these videos start to come out showing bodies piled in buildings, sometimes fighters executing wounded people lying on the ground, often quite casually.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们看到这些视频开始流出，显示尸体堆积在建筑物中，有时武装人员会随手处决躺在地上的伤员。

sentences.en: These videos, it must be said, are filmed by the fighters themselves as kind of trophies for the war, which is a pattern we've seen since the start of the Sudan war.
sentences.zh: 必须指出的是，这些视频是由武装人员自己拍摄的，作为一种战争战利品，这是我们自苏丹战争开始以来就看到的模式。

sentences.en: And since then, that's been added to by accounts from witnesses, from people who fled the city, from aid groups,
sentences.zh: 从那以后，目击者、逃离该市的人、援助组织提供的叙述也加入了进来，

sentences.en: and now from open source investigators who are using satellite images to try and determine what's been happening in Al-Fashir.
sentences.zh: 现在还有开源调查人员，他们正在利用卫星图像试图确定法希尔发生了什么。

sentences.en: And just last week, a new report from one of those groups saying that they had uncovered evidence that 80 people had been killed in one specific incident.
sentences.zh: 就在上周，其中一个组织发布了一份新报告，称他们发现了80人在一次特定事件中被杀害的证据。

sentences.en: Others have found traces, in fact, from satellites of blood on the sands of the area around Al-Fashir.
sentences.zh: 其他人甚至通过卫星在法希尔周围地区的沙地上发现了血迹。

sentences.en: This is, of course, coming 20 years after another bloody conflict made Darfur basically a byword for human rights atrocities.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是在另一场血腥冲突使达尔富尔基本上成为侵犯人权暴行的代名词20年后发生的。

sentences.en: Can you talk to us about what is different this time?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我们谈谈这次有什么不同吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, 20 years ago, Darfur, in fact, became synonymous with the word genocide.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，20年前，达尔富尔实际上成了“种族灭绝”这个词的代名词。

sentences.en: And that's because at that time, there was an armed militia called the Janjaweed that was leading a lot of the killing in Darfur, a conflict that killed as many as 300,000 people.
sentences.zh: 那是因为当时有一个名为“金戈威德”的武装民兵组织在达尔富尔领导了大部分杀戮，那场冲突导致多达30万人死亡。

sentences.en: The difference this time is that the Janjaweed has been replaced by another group called the Rapid Support Forces.
sentences.zh: 这次的不同之处在于，“金戈威德”已被另一个名为“快速支援部队”的组织所取代。

sentences.en: Effectively, it's Descendant.
sentences.zh: 实际上，它是其后裔。

sentences.en: And that group is better armed than ever before.
sentences.zh: 而且该组织比以往任何时候都装备精良。

sentences.en: In the past, the Janjaweed fought with horses and camels.
sentences.zh: 过去，“金戈威德”骑着马和骆驼作战。

sentences.en: This time, the Rapid Support Forces have got armored vehicles, extremely sophisticated Chinese drones.
sentences.zh: 这一次，“快速支援部队”拥有装甲车和极其先进的中国无人机。

sentences.en: Last time, the Janjaweed were fighting alongside Sudan's army.
sentences.zh: 上次，“金戈威德”与苏丹军队并肩作战。

sentences.en: This time, it's fighting against the army.
sentences.zh: 这一次，它是在与军队作战。

sentences.en: And its ambitions are no longer limited to control of Darfur.
sentences.zh: 而且它的野心不再局限于控制达尔富尔。

sentences.en: Darfur, it's part of this struggle for control of the entire country.
sentences.zh: 达尔富尔，它是这场争夺整个国家控制权斗争的一部分。

sentences.en: Since the war started over two years ago, at least 12 million people have been forced from their homes in Sudan.
sentences.zh: 自两年多前战争开始以来，苏丹至少有1200万人被迫背井离乡。

sentences.en: As many as 400,000 have been killed by some estimates.
sentences.zh: 据一些估计，多达40万人被杀害。

sentences.en: And about half the country is facing acute hunger, with many instances of declared famine, mostly in the same region of Darfur.
sentences.zh: 全国约一半人口面临严重的饥饿，在达尔富尔同一地区出现了许多宣布饥荒的案例。

sentences.en: And that's part of this civil war that's been raging in Sudan for the last two and a half years.
sentences.zh: 这是苏丹过去两年半来一直肆虐的内战的一部分。

sentences.en: And that war has led to what is now widely recognized as the world's largest humanitarian crisis.
sentences.zh: 那场战争导致了现在被广泛认为是世界上最大的人道主义危机。

sentences.en: These numbers are obviously staggering.
sentences.zh: 这些数字显然令人震惊。

sentences.en: You mentioned 400,000 people have been killed.
sentences.zh: 你提到有40万人被杀害。

sentences.en: And I want to talk about what is driving this conflict, which is something that you have spent a lot of time trying to report out.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈是什么在驱动这场冲突，这是你花了很多时间试图报道的事情。

sentences.en: And you're reporting one of Pulitzer, actually, this year.
sentences.zh: 而且你今年还因此获得了一项普利策奖。

sentences.en: Tell us about what you have learned about why this conflict has gotten so bloody.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们你了解到的关于这场冲突为何变得如此血腥的原因。

sentences.en: Well, when it started in April 2023, it looked quite simply like a power struggle between two rival generals at the top of Sudan's security forces.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当它在2023年4月开始时，看起来很简单，就像苏丹安全部队高层的两名敌对将军之间的权力斗争。

sentences.en: But very quickly, that conflict spread from the capital Khartoum across the country, engulfing Africa's third largest country.
sentences.zh: 但很快，冲突就从首都喀土穆蔓延到全国，吞噬了非洲第三大国。

sentences.en: And, you know, the next logical question that stemmed from that for me was how are they all funding it?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，随之而来的下一个逻辑问题对我来说是：他们都是如何资助这场战争的？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, follow the money really became a central part of our reporting.
sentences.zh: 所以，“追踪资金”确实成了我们报道的核心部分。

sentences.en: And in part, that's what brought me to Khartoum earlier this year at a very dramatic moment, just as the city was changing hands.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这就是我今年早些时候来到喀土穆的原因，当时正值城市易手的关键时刻。

sentences.en: And what did the capital look like at that point after about, I guess, two years of war?
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我想大概两年战争后，首都看起来是什么样子的？

sentences.en: It was absolutely devastated.
sentences.zh: 它被彻底摧毁了。

sentences.en: You know, previously, just to paint you a brief picture, this was a very proud city on the Nile.
sentences.zh: 你知道，以前，简单给你描绘一下，这是一座位于尼罗河畔、非常引以为傲的城市。

sentences.en: This is a country that had significant oil resources, deep gold resources.
sentences.zh: 这是一个拥有丰富石油资源、深厚黄金资源的国家。

sentences.en: It had a growing middle class.
sentences.zh: 它曾经有一个不断壮大的中产阶级。

sentences.en: And now, much of the city had been laid to waste.
sentences.zh: 而现在，城市的大部分地区已沦为废墟。

sentences.en: Entire neighborhoods of homes that had been looted, buildings destroyed.
sentences.zh: 整个社区的房屋被洗劫一空，建筑物被摧毁。

sentences.en: And in particular, the city center around the presidential palace.
sentences.zh: 特别是总统府周围的市中心。

sentences.en: The presidential palace had become one of its biggest battlegrounds.
sentences.zh: 总统府已成为其最大的战场之一。

sentences.en: At one point, we climbed into a sniper's nest beside the Nile River and overlooking that palace.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我们爬进尼罗河边俯瞰总统府的一个狙击手巢穴。

sentences.en: And it was amazing to see how it had been absolutely reduced to rubble by the fighting.
sentences.zh: 看到它被战斗彻底夷为平地，真是令人震惊。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just that.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此。

sentences.en: The entire city center, many tall buildings, were also pocked with bullet marks and have been turned into fighting positions.
sentences.zh: 整个市中心，许多高层建筑，也布满了弹孔，并被改造成了战斗阵地。

sentences.en: It was really incredible to see how an entire city could be reduced to rubble by this two years of war.
sentences.zh: 看到整座城市在两年的战争中沦为废墟，真是令人难以置信。

sentences.en: Largely, it must be said, without being seen by the outside world.
sentences.zh: 必须说，这在很大程度上是在外界未曾察觉的情况下发生的。

sentences.en: As the Sudanese military pushed into new areas, we followed them.
sentences.zh: 当苏丹军队推进到新区域时，我们跟随他们。

sentences.en: Often came across residents who were emerging from their homes, kind of stunned.
sentences.zh: 经常遇到从家里走出来的居民，他们看起来有些目瞪口呆。

sentences.en: I was frightened and ran away.
sentences.zh: 我很害怕，就跑开了。

sentences.en: We talked to this one man who'd seen his neighbor get gunned down by RSF fighters.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了一名男子，他亲眼目睹邻居被“快速支援部队”的武装人员枪杀。

sentences.en: He heard the shooting, came out from his house.
sentences.zh: 他听到了枪声，从屋里出来。

sentences.en: He wanted to know what was happening.
sentences.zh: 他想知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: So the militia of a man, he was shot by cold blood.
sentences.zh: 所以那个人的民兵，他被冷血地枪杀了。

sentences.en: And others brought these stories about abuse, about starvation, about people being killed.
sentences.zh: 其他人也带来了关于虐待、饥饿和人们被杀害的故事。

sentences.en: At one point, we found ourselves at a well that contained maybe a dozen bodies.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我们在一口井里发现了大约十几具尸体。

sentences.en: And we were told that these were people who had been killed by fighters at a nearby checkpoint and dumped there.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知，这些人是在附近的检查站被武装人员杀害并扔在那里的。

sentences.en: What was it like to report in that kind of environment?
sentences.zh: 在那样的环境下进行报道是什么感觉？

sentences.en: And what kind of clues could you find to answer your question about what is funding and fueling all of this destruction?
sentences.zh: 你发现了什么线索来回答关于是什么在资助和助长所有这些破坏的问题？

sentences.en: Well, as we went through the city, we found ourselves in the abandoned villas of some of the RSF leaders.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我们穿过城市时，我们发现自己身处一些“快速支援部队”领导人废弃的别墅中。

sentences.en: In one of them in particular, there were fighters lounging outside this empty swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 特别是在其中一栋房子里，有武装人员在这个空游泳池外闲逛。

sentences.en: The house had an internal elevator.
sentences.zh: 房子里有内部电梯。

sentences.en: You know, sort of markings of wealth that were such a contrast with the scenes we were seeing outside.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这种财富的标志与我们在外面看到的场景形成了鲜明对比。

sentences.en: And so, as we walked through this house, I also found this sheaf of papers that evidently had been abandoned by the RSF leaders as they left.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们走过这栋房子时，我还发现了一叠显然是“快速支援部队”领导人在离开时遗弃的文件。

sentences.en: And when we examined them more closely, they turned out to be corporate documents related to gold mines run by the same armed group in the south of the country.
sentences.zh: 当我们仔细检查它们时，发现它们是与该国南部由同一武装组织经营的金矿有关的公司文件。

sentences.en: And this was a really important clue into what was funding a lot of the fighting.
sentences.zh: 这是关于是什么在资助大部分战斗的一个非常重要的线索。

sentences.en: We already knew that, you know, Sudan had a huge gold industry going back many years.
sentences.zh: 我们已经知道，你知道，苏丹多年前就有一个巨大的黄金产业。

sentences.en: But it was very difficult to get a sense of just how important it had become to these groups that were fighting for control and how much it was fueling the fight itself.
sentences.zh: 但很难了解它对这些争夺控制权的组织变得多么重要，以及它在多大程度上助长了战斗本身。

sentences.en: And here was this clue that really set us further along this track of trying to uncover what's really driving this destructive war in Sudan.
sentences.zh: 而这里有一个线索，确实让我们在试图揭开苏丹这场破坏性战争背后真正驱动力的道路上更进一步。

sentences.en: It seems unusual that a war could be boiled down to something as simple as gold.
sentences.zh: 战争可以归结为黄金这样简单的事情，这似乎很不寻常。

sentences.en: It does remind me of the blood diamonds that fuel the conflict in Sierra Leone.
sentences.zh: 这确实让我想起了助长塞拉利昂冲突的“血钻”。

sentences.en: But I'm curious if you see it this way.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇你是否也这样看。

sentences.en: Well, look, you're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，你是完全正确的。

sentences.en: There is a strong parallel between the issue of blood diamonds that were so famous years ago from West Africa and the importance of gold in this conflict.
sentences.zh: 多年前西非著名的“血钻”问题与黄金在这场冲突中的重要性之间存在着强烈的相似之处。

sentences.en: But, you know, Sudan's war is about many things.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，苏丹的战争涉及很多方面。

sentences.en: The fight between these two generals exposed this much deeper rift in the country, tensions that go back to the genocide 20 years ago in Sudan that were never really healed.
sentences.zh: 这两位将军之间的斗争暴露了该国更深层的裂痕，这些紧张局势可以追溯到20年前苏丹的种族灭绝，从未真正愈合。

sentences.en: And now they've become mixed with ethnic problems, political problems, and focused inside this war that has engulfed the whole country.
sentences.zh: 现在它们与种族问题、政治问题交织在一起，集中在这场吞噬了整个国家的战争中。

sentences.en: But on top of that, this is a country with a lot of rich agricultural land.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，这是一个拥有大量肥沃农田的国家。

sentences.en: It's got ports on the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 它在红海上有港口。

sentences.en: It's a huge country.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的国家。

sentences.en: So there are many reasons to fight over it.
sentences.zh: 所以争夺它的理由有很多。

sentences.en: But gold is the one thing that is easy to mine in the middle of the conflict.
sentences.zh: 但黄金是在冲突中容易开采的东西。

sentences.en: And that now, of course, is worth so much money.
sentences.zh: 而且现在，当然，它价值连城。

sentences.en: Gold prices are higher than they've ever been.
sentences.zh: 金价处于历史最高水平。

sentences.en: Declan, can you talk a little bit about the gold economy, how much it's worth, if we have any idea, how the gold actually moves and whose hands actually touch it along the way?
sentences.zh: 德克兰，你能谈谈黄金经济吗？它价值多少？如果我们有任何概念的话，黄金实际上是如何流动的，以及沿途谁的手真正接触过它？

sentences.en: Well, look, most of it is smuggled.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，大部分都是走私的。

sentences.en: So we don't know exactly.
sentences.zh: 所以我们并不确切知道。

sentences.en: But it's certainly, by most estimates, is worth billions of dollars every year.
sentences.zh: 但根据大多数估计，它每年的价值肯定达数十亿美元。

sentences.en: And it's a huge factor on both sides of the war, but particularly for the RSF.
sentences.zh: 它是战争双方的一个巨大因素，尤其是对“快速支援部队”而言。

sentences.en: And the leader of the group, his name is Lieutenant General Mohammed Hamdan, widely known as Hemeti, is a commander who in many ways came to prominence as a result of gold.
sentences.zh: 该组织的领导人，名叫穆罕默德·哈姆丹中将，广为人知的是“赫梅蒂”，他是一位在很多方面因黄金而声名鹊起的指挥官。

sentences.en: Back in 2017, his forces seized one of the largest gold mines in the country.
sentences.zh: 早在2017年，他的部队就夺取了该国最大的金矿之一。

sentences.en: And that became a bedrock of the expansion of his military forces,
sentences.zh: 那成了他军事力量扩张的基石，

sentences.en: but also of this sort of business empire that he built up that helped to make him such a power broker in the country.
sentences.zh: 也成了他建立的某种商业帝国的基石，这使他成为该国的权力掮客。

sentences.en: How has this General Hemeti managed to both fight a war and mine for gold at the same time?
sentences.zh: 这位赫梅蒂将军是如何设法在打仗的同时又开采黄金的？

sentences.en: Like, how does that operation work exactly?
sentences.zh: 比如，那个行动到底是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: To be clear, his forces aren't mining the gold themselves.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，他的部队并不是自己在开采黄金。

sentences.en: He relies on this enormous pool of people in Sudan who are willing to work in really terrible conditions to get the gold out of the ground.
sentences.zh: 他依赖苏丹庞大的劳动力群体，这些人愿意在非常恶劣的条件下工作，把黄金从地下挖出来。

sentences.en: Very little of it in his areas are extracted through what you might think of as a classic industrial mine with lots of heavy machinery and so on.
sentences.zh: 在他控制的地区，很少有黄金是通过你可能认为的经典工业矿山开采的，即拥有大量重型机械等等。

sentences.en: What actually happens is you've got thousands, sometimes tens of thousands of people who are extracting this gold in really rudimentary ways, hacking it out of the ground,
sentences.zh: 实际发生的情况是，有成千上万，有时是数万人在以非常原始的方式提取这种黄金，从地下挖掘出来，

sentences.en: literally using pickaxes, pulling the ore out of the ground.
sentences.zh: 字面上是用镐，把矿石从地下拉出来。

sentences.en: I've seen it firsthand myself when I visited some gold mining operations in Sudan a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 几年前我访问苏丹的一些金矿作业时，曾亲眼目睹过。

sentences.en: And then they run it through this very rudimentary process to sift it using some pretty simple machines.
sentences.zh: 然后他们通过这个非常原始的过程，使用一些相当简单的机器来筛选它。

sentences.en: Then they use mercury to help separate out the gold.
sentences.zh: 然后他们使用汞来帮助分离黄金。

sentences.en: That's extremely dangerous for people's health, obviously.
sentences.zh: 显然，这对人们的健康极其危险。

sentences.en: And then eventually that gold is processed into sort of semi-pure bars.
sentences.zh: 然后最终，黄金被加工成半纯金条。

sentences.en: And then the tailings or the waste from that is further processed again.
sentences.zh: 然后尾矿或其中的废物被进一步处理。

sentences.en: And they extract the rest of the gold from that.
sentences.zh: 他们从中提取剩余的黄金。

sentences.en: So that's what's known as artisanal gold mining, as opposed to industrial mining, which involves classically, as we would think of, a large plant with, you know,
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓的“手工采金”，而不是工业采矿，工业采矿通常涉及我们所认为的拥有大型工厂，你知道，

sentences.en: huge amounts of earth being moved around.
sentences.zh: 大量的土方被移动。

sentences.en: So in many ways, the RSF and General Hamdam have relied on the fact that Sudan is such a poor country.
sentences.zh: 所以在很多方面，“快速支援部队”和哈姆丹将军依赖于苏丹是一个贫穷国家的事实。

sentences.en: And there are so many people who are available to do this really tough work to get that ore out of the ground and process it into gold.
sentences.zh: 有很多人可以从事这种非常艰苦的工作，把矿石从地下挖出来并加工成黄金。

sentences.en: Given what we know about how desperate the situation has been in Sudan, how poor people are, obviously there's been a famine for many years, and how brutal the RSF has been,
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们所知道的苏丹局势有多么绝望，人们有多贫穷，显然多年来一直有饥荒，而且“快速支援部队”有多残暴，

sentences.en: would you call it forced labor?
sentences.zh: 你会称之为强迫劳动吗？

sentences.en: Is it slave labor?
sentences.zh: 这是奴隶劳动吗？

sentences.en: No, I would call it desperate labor.
sentences.zh: 不，我会称之为绝望的劳作。

sentences.en: These are people who are turning to gold mining because, frankly, there's no other source of income left.
sentences.zh: 这些人转向金矿开采，坦白说，是因为他们已经没有其他收入来源了。

sentences.en: The war has devastated the country's economy.
sentences.zh: 战争摧毁了这个国家的经济。

sentences.en: This is a country that has a lot of very fertile land and had other sources of income.
sentences.zh: 这个国家原本拥有大量肥沃的土地和其他收入来源。

sentences.en: So you've seen these areas that are now almost entirely controlled by RSF fighters, sometimes with a pretty brutal regime over these gold mines.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到这些地区现在几乎完全由快速支援部队（RSF）控制，有时这些金矿还处于相当残酷的统治之下。

sentences.en: But people are flocking to it from across the region because that's the only way they can get money to feed themselves or their families.
sentences.zh: 但来自该地区各地的人们仍蜂拥而至，因为这是他们获取钱财以养活自己或家人的唯一途径。

sentences.en: But it's important to say that the RSF isn't doing this alone.
sentences.zh: 但必须指出的是，快速支援部队并非孤军奋战。

sentences.en: Before the war, it was working with mercenaries from the Wagner Group.
sentences.zh: 战争爆发前，它一直与瓦格纳集团的雇佣兵合作。

sentences.en: That's the Russian private military company that's become such a powerful force in this part of Africa.
sentences.zh: 那是俄罗斯的一家私营军事公司，已成为非洲这一地区的一股强大力量。

sentences.en: That's very closely tied to the Kremlin, right?
sentences.zh: 它与克里姆林宫联系非常紧密，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, very closely tied to the Kremlin, now known in some other places as Africa Corps.
sentences.zh: 是的，与克里姆林宫联系非常紧密，现在在其他一些地方被称为“非洲军团”。

sentences.en: But in this part of the world, they still call it Wagner.
sentences.zh: 但在世界这一地区，他们仍然称其为瓦格纳。

sentences.en: And so Wagner was working with the RSF before the war, helping to extract the gold from some of these areas or to secure the gold as they transported it out of the country.
sentences.zh: 所以瓦格纳在战前就与快速支援部队合作，帮助从这些地区开采黄金，或在黄金运出该国时提供安全保障。

sentences.en: A lot of it seems to have ended up ultimately in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 其中很多黄金最终似乎都流向了莫斯科。

sentences.en: And in the war itself, our reporting indicated that Wagner or the Russian mercenaries have continued to work with the RSF in parts of Darfur,
sentences.zh: 而在战争本身中，我们的报道显示，瓦格纳或俄罗斯雇佣兵在达尔富尔的部分地区继续与快速支援部队合作，

sentences.en: particularly in this extremely remote area called Songo, where you've got dozens of these small gold mines dotted around the terrain where people are mining for gold.
sentences.zh: 特别是在一个极其偏远的地区，叫松戈（Songo），那里有几十个小型金矿散布在地形中，人们在那里淘金。

sentences.en: But also there is a central location where what they call the tailings, that's the sort of the waste from the initial pass on the gold, is processed.
sentences.zh: 但还有一个中心地点，专门处理所谓的“尾矿”，也就是初次淘金后留下的废料。

sentences.en: And that provides an entirely new process for extracting gold that is almost entirely in the hands of the RSF and their Russian partners.
sentences.zh: 这提供了一种全新的黄金提取工艺，几乎完全掌握在快速支援部队及其俄罗斯合作伙伴手中。

sentences.en: So you've just laid out very comprehensively one side of the conflict.
sentences.zh: 你已经非常全面地阐述了冲突的一方。

sentences.en: Tell us about how gold fuels the other side of the conflict.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我们黄金是如何助长冲突另一方的。

sentences.en: Sudan's military is also deeply dependent on gold.
sentences.zh: 苏丹军方也深陷对黄金的依赖。

sentences.en: It's a somewhat different structure on the other side of the country.
sentences.zh: 在国家另一侧，结构略有不同。

sentences.en: Over there in the eastern and northern Sudan, there are a handful of these large industrial style mines.
sentences.zh: 在苏丹东部和北部，有少数几个大型工业化矿场。

sentences.en: And in fact, production of gold, according to the official figures, has now ramped up to the point where more gold is being extracted over there than ever before,
sentences.zh: 事实上，根据官方数据，黄金产量现已大幅提升，那里的黄金开采量比以往任何时候都要多，

sentences.en: even during the relative peace before the war started.
sentences.zh: 甚至超过了战前相对和平时期的产量。

sentences.en: So the military controls or has a stake in several of these huge mines.
sentences.zh: 所以军方控制着或参股了其中几个大型矿场。

sentences.en: And the military, like the RSF, runs some of these mines in association with foreign players, including some Russian business people.
sentences.zh: 而且军方和快速支援部队一样，与外国参与者（包括一些俄罗斯商人）合作经营着其中一些矿场。

sentences.en: So Russia, in some ways, is supporting and potentially benefiting from both sides of this conflict.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，俄罗斯既在支持这场冲突的双方，也可能从中受益。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Declan, you have both sides of this conflict using gold to fund their war efforts.
sentences.zh: 德克兰，你提到冲突双方都在利用黄金资助他们的战争努力。

sentences.en: It's obviously any kind of commodity needs a buyer.
sentences.zh: 显然，任何商品都需要买家。

sentences.en: Who is purchasing all of this gold?
sentences.zh: 是谁在购买这些黄金？

sentences.en: Well, we found that nearly all of this gold, which has funded so much of the fighting and created so much misery and destruction in the country, goes to a single destination.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们发现几乎所有这些资助了大量战斗、在全国造成了巨大苦难和破坏的黄金，都流向了同一个目的地。

sentences.en: And that's a country that has a deep interest in the war and could be the solution to ending it.
sentences.zh: 而那个国家对这场战争有着深厚的利益，也可能是结束战争的关键。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Declan, you mentioned that all of this gold is going to a single destination.
sentences.zh: 德克兰，你提到所有这些黄金都流向了同一个目的地。

sentences.en: Where is it going, and how did you report that out?
sentences.zh: 它流向了哪里？你是如何报道出这一点的？

sentences.en: It's really hard to trace gold.
sentences.zh: 追踪黄金确实很难。

sentences.en: You know, it can be melted down.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它可以被熔化。

sentences.en: It can be mixed with gold from other places.
sentences.zh: 它可以与其他地方的黄金混合。

sentences.en: It doesn't have a sort of geological signature in the same way as diamonds do, for instance.
sentences.zh: 它不像钻石那样具有某种地质特征。

sentences.en: So I reached out to contacts in countries all around Sudan.
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了苏丹周边国家的线人。

sentences.en: We went through flight records, company files, in an effort to pull the thread of one single
sentences.zh: 我们查阅了飞行记录、公司档案，试图理清一条线索，即一笔

sentences.en: shipment of gold that was coming out of the war zone and ending up in international markets.
sentences.zh: 来自战区的黄金运输，最终进入了国际市场。

sentences.en: And that led us to this instance of a single shipment of about $25 million worth of gold that was mined in Darfur, in the middle of the war zone, was smuggled out through South
sentences.zh: 这引导我们发现了这样一个实例：一笔价值约2500万美元的黄金，在战争中心的达尔富尔开采，通过邻国南苏丹走私出境，

sentences.en: Sudan, neighboring country, and that ended up on this luxury jet, which had been chartered from an American company and flown hundreds of miles across into the Persian Gulf to the
sentences.zh: 最终装上了一架从美国公司租用的豪华喷气式飞机，飞行数百英里跨越波斯湾，抵达了

sentences.en: country of the United Arab Emirates, which, as it turns out, is where 90% of smuggled gold from the continent of Africa ends up and nearly all of Sudanese gold is traded as well.
sentences.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国。事实证明，非洲90%的走私黄金最终都流向了那里，几乎所有的苏丹黄金也是在那里交易的。

sentences.en: So, okay, that's what it took to trace just one shipment.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是追踪一笔运输所需要做的工作。

sentences.en: How much money overall are we talking about that's flowing from Sudan to the UAE?
sentences.zh: 从苏丹流向阿联酋的黄金总额到底有多少？

sentences.en: We are talking about billions of dollars in gold.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是数十亿美元的黄金。

sentences.en: A lot of it is undeclared, so it's hard to know exactly how much.
sentences.zh: 其中很多是未申报的，所以很难确切知道有多少。

sentences.en: But there was a study a few years ago by a Swiss group, which found that in the decade from 2012
sentences.zh: 但几年前有一个瑞士组织的研究发现，在2012年到2022年的十年间，

sentences.en: to 2022, $115 billion worth of undeclared gold from Africa had ended up in the UAE, and certainly a decent proportion of that would have come from Sudan.
sentences.zh: 价值1150亿美元的非洲未申报黄金最终流向了阿联酋，其中肯定有相当一部分来自苏丹。

sentences.en: It's a part of the UAE economy that often gets obscured by the country's image, which tends to focus around its gleaming skyscrapers or its place as a location for reality TV shows
sentences.zh: 这是阿联酋经济的一部分，经常被该国的形象所掩盖，其形象往往聚焦于闪闪发光的摩天大楼、真人秀节目的拍摄地，

sentences.en: or a certain amount of glamour.
sentences.zh: 或者某种魅力。

sentences.en: But, you know, the truth is that since the Emirates was a poor country seven or eight decades ago, it has had this gold industry, and that gold industry has increased in leaps
sentences.zh: 但你知道，事实是，自七八十年前阿联酋还是个贫穷国家以来，它就一直拥有这个黄金产业，而且近年来这个黄金产业突飞猛进，

sentences.en: and bounds in recent years, and a lot of the gold that is traded there comes from Africa, and most of that gold, like the gold that comes from Sudan, is smuggled.
sentences.zh: 在那里交易的很多黄金都来自非洲，而其中大部分黄金，就像来自苏丹的黄金一样，都是走私的。

sentences.en: And what have the Emirates said about their role in funding this conflict?
sentences.zh: 那么阿联酋对于他们在资助这场冲突中的角色有何回应？

sentences.en: Well, the Emirates staunchly denies that it supports either side in the conflict, and in fact says that its main goal in Sudan is to work towards peace.
sentences.zh: 嗯，阿联酋坚决否认支持冲突中的任何一方，事实上还声称其在苏丹的主要目标是致力于和平。

sentences.en: But that contrasts with what we found in our own reporting and what's been said by numerous
sentences.zh: 但这与我们在自己的报道中发现的情况，以及包括人权组织、联合国调查人员，甚至是对该议题进行过情报简报的美国议员在内的众多其他消息来源所说的话相矛盾。

sentences.en: other sources, including human rights groups, United Nations investigators, and even American lawmakers who've had intelligence briefings on this subject.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都指向阿联酋向快速支援部队提供武器。

sentences.en: And all of that points to the Emirates supplying weapons to the RSF.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道甚至显示，一些走私活动是在人道主义援助中最受尊敬的象征之一——红新月会和红十字会的旗帜下进行的。

sentences.en: Our reporting even showed that some of this smuggling has taken place under the flag of one of the most respected symbols in humanitarian aid, the Red Crescent and the Red Cross.
sentences.zh: 阿联酋人提供了无人机，提供了雇佣兵来帮助快速支援部队，他们还给予了该组织政治支持。

sentences.en: And the Emiratis have supplied drones, they've supplied mercenaries to help the RSF, and they've also given political support to the group.
sentences.zh: 去年，快速支援部队领导人赫梅蒂对几个非洲国家进行了访问，在那里他会见了总理和总统，试图美化自己的形象。

sentences.en: Last year, Hemeti, the leader of the RSF, did a tour of several African countries in which he met prime ministers and presidents and attempted to sort of burnish his image.
sentences.zh: 他乘坐的是一架由阿联酋提供的波音喷气式飞机。

sentences.en: And he did that on a Boeing jet which had been supplied by the UAE.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，事实证明阿联酋在该国最大的政府控制的工业化金矿之一中拥有所有权股份。

sentences.en: At the same time, it turns out the Emirates has an ownership stake in one of the largest government-controlled industrialized gold mines in the country.
sentences.zh: 那就是库什（Kush）金矿。

sentences.en: That's called the Kush mine.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，有证据表明阿联酋在武装战争的一方，同时在资助另一方。

sentences.en: In other words, there's evidence that the UAE is arming one side in the war while funding the other.
sentences.zh: 所以阿联酋在这里是在两头下注。

sentences.en: So the UAE is hedging its bets here.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有谈到美国以及美国在结束这场战争中可能扮演的角色。

sentences.en: We haven't talked about the United States and any role that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，美国一直深陷于结束乌克兰和加沙的战争，但我们几乎没有听到任何关于美国打算如何处理苏丹问题的消息。

sentences.en: might have in ending this war.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府公开对此有何说法？

sentences.en: So far, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果我能简要回顾一下上一届政府，即拜登政府，至少在一些官员中，确实对苏丹正在发生的事情有很多担忧。

sentences.en: has been deeply invested in ending the wars in Ukraine and Gaza, but we have heard next to nothing about anything that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府认识到阿联酋是助长战争的主要因素，并私下向阿联酋施压试图阻止这一点，但收效甚微。

sentences.en: intends to do vis-a-vis Sudan.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府最初似乎并不太关心苏丹，但随着近几个月情况恶化，特别是我们之前谈到的法希尔市的围困加剧，

sentences.en: What has the Trump administration said publicly about this?
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府突然对苏丹问题投入了更多关注。

sentences.en: Well, if I can peddle back just briefly to the previous administration, the Biden administration, there has certainly been a lot of U.S.
sentences.zh: 自九月以来，我们看到美国组建了这个外交小组，称之为“四方集团”，其中包括来自美国、沙特阿拉伯、阿拉伯联合酋长国和埃及的外交官。

sentences.en: concern, among some officials at least, about what's going on in Sudan.
